You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 1e9fc1e7aed34e48c04e0ec437a4520b66637e1b Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Anatolij Gustschin <agust@denx.de>
Date: Mon, 13 Jun 2016 22:52:08 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] handler: fix build error

The build is broken if CONFIG_HANDLER_IN_LUA is not defined.
Fix error introduced by commit 4ee18771.

Signed-off-by: Anatolij Gustschin <agust@denx.de>
---
 core/handler.c | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/core/handler.c b/core/handler.c
index 2cc684fe..99ae3c99 100644
--- a/core/handler.c
+++ b/core/handler.c
@@ -207,7 +207,7 @@ int lua_handlers_init(void)
 	return ret;
 }
 #else
-int lua_handlers_init(void) {0}
+int lua_handlers_init(void) {return 0;}
 #endif
 
 int register_handler(const char *desc,
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by a build error that occurred when the configuration option `CONFIG_HANDLER_IN_LUA` was not defined. In this case, the function `lua_handlers_init` was incorrectly defined to return an empty function body (`{0}`), which is not valid C syntax. The patch corrects this by changing the function definition to return `0`, ensuring that the function has a proper return statement and resolves the build error.

    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by a build error that occurred when the configuration option `CONFIG_HANDLER_IN_LUA` was not defined. In this case, the function `lua_handlers_init` was incorrectly defined to return an empty function body (`{0}`), which is not valid C syntax. The patch corrects this by changing the function definition to return `0`, ensuring that the function has a proper return statement and resolves the build error.
